items.title: SpaceX Makes History With Successful Rocket Catch in Texas
items.en: SpaceX Makes History With Successful Rocket Catch in Texas. The Starship spacecraft returned from orbit to the same spot where it lifted off, marking a key milestone in SpaceX’s vision of building fully reusable rockets.
